# Sarah Ateia Khattab, M.S., LPC Associate, NCC

> Counseling in person in the Dallas–Fort Worth area (based in Irving, TX) and by telehealth across Texas, in English and Arabic. Self-pay with sliding fee scale options. Free 15-minute phone consultation.

## Practice details

- Credentials: Licensed Professional Counselor Associate (LPC Associate) #104391, Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council; National Certified Counselor (NCC) #1746909, NBCC
- Supervision: practices under the supervision of Don Zablosky, LPC-S
- Education: M.S., Psychology – Counseling & Human Development, Texas Woman's University; B.S., Psychology, The University of Texas at Dallas
- Formats: in person in Dallas–Fort Worth; telehealth for clients located in Texas at the time of each session
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Fees: self-pay only, no insurance billing; sliding fee scale options available; clients may request a Good Faith Estimate
- Areas of focus: anxiety and stress, low mood, emotional overwhelm, nervous system regulation, relationship patterns, burnout, identity and self-understanding, self-esteem, genetics-informed psychoeducation (educational only, not medical advice)
- Contact: (972) 482-9526 · attya.llc@gmail.com
- Business entity: Attya LLC

## Important

- Not a crisis service. In crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or go to the nearest emergency room.
- Genetics-related discussion is educational only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment; no lab ordering or interpretation.
